modes.FULL: external plus sovereign/local lanes and all decision courts available
modes.DEGRADED_EXTERNAL_PARTIAL: one or more external lanes succeed but full diversity not met
modes.DEGRADED_LOCAL_ONLY: external unavailable; authorized sovereign/local lanes continue
modes.DEGRADED_DETERMINISTIC_ONLY: model lanes unavailable; deterministic analysis continues
modes.CHECKPOINT_ONLY: no safe executable review lane remains; durable state preserved
